subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` as a standalone public config key now, and if so must it cover local AgentSession compaction or be documented as embedded-only?
rationale: The PR adds compatibility-sensitive config surface, overlaps broader per-agent compaction work, and intentionally cannot affect Codex-native compaction beyond warning, so maintainer scope intent is needed before merge.

options.title: Accept after full runtime/docs coverage
options.body: Require local AgentSession wiring, public docs, Codex-native limitation text, and redacted proof before considering the key merge-ready.

options.title: Narrow to embedded-only
options.body: Allow the key only for embedded direct compaction and make the local/Codex-native limitations explicit in schema help and docs.

options.title: Fold into per-agent overrides
options.body: Pause this focused PR and let the broader per-agent compaction override direction absorb thinking-level behavior when that branch becomes viable.

recommendation.title: Accept after full runtime/docs coverage
recommendation.body: Require local AgentSession wiring, public docs, Codex-native limitation text, and redacted proof before considering the key merge-ready.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to jalehman and the repository contributor guide lists that handle for Compaction and Context Engine decisions.
